verdicts.reason: In A the hierarchy is flipped: the headline 'Order online' shrinks until it is smaller than the 'food & drinks' subline, which floats far to the right and runs over the kraft box, so text sits on a busy image. The rules also no longer frame the text block. B has every A flaw and adds a direct collision: the headline jams against 'food & drinks', the subline covers the box image even more heavily, and the rules sit away from the type.
